title: On a conjecture of Marton
judgment_notes: Gowers-Green-Manners-Tao, On a conjecture of Marton. Blueprint covers the whole paper plus later extensions (2404.09639, 2404.02244), so it is a superset of the paper.

source.citation: Gowers, Green, Manners, Tao, On a conjecture of Marton (Annals of Math. 2025; arXiv 2023)
source.scope: whole paper (33 pp.) plus later extensions: Liao exponent improvement, torsion-group / integer versions (2404.02244), 2404.09639
source.evidence: README: "Lean4 formalization of the proof of the Polynomial Freiman-Ruzsa (PFR) conjecture (https://arxiv.org/abs/2311.05762)"; second stage added Liao's argument and consequences.

edge_sample.target_text: proof : Immediate from \Cref{sumset-lower} and \Cref{ruz-dist-def}, and also \Cref{neg-ent}.

edge_sample.source_text: theorem PFR: If $A \subset {\bf F}_2^n$ is non-empty and $|A+A| \leq K|A|$, then $A$ can be covered by most $2K^{12}$ translates of a subspace $H$ of ${\bf F}_2^n$ with $|H| \leq |A|$.

edge_sample.source_text: lemma Chain rule: If $X: \Omega \to S$ and $Y: \Omega \to T$ are random variables, then $$ \bbH[X, Y] = \bbH[Y] + \bbH[X|Y].$$
